title: Tim Taylor's secret space program and timeline adjusting

tellings.quote: operative Tim Taylor. In the book, Pulka claims that Taylor was part of a secret space program involving UFOs.

plain: An operative named Tim Taylor is said to have belonged to a secret space program, a hidden effort to fly in space outside public knowledge, and one that involved UFOs. Michels takes this from American Cosmic, a book by the writer Diana Pasulka, and says it is her claim in the book, not something he checked himself. If true, it would mean some people already work with UFOs in a space effort nobody has been told about.
